$comment: Topic queue for reaching 25+ entries. Chosen for search volume, a single identifiable root-cause family, and the existence of primary sources that can be quoted verbatim. Domain balance matters: the corpus started 4/7 kubernetes, which reads as a Kubernetes site rather than an engineering one.

queue.error: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource
queue.why: Among the highest-volume web errors there is. Almost always misdiagnosed as a frontend bug when it is a server response-header problem.

queue.error: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
queue.why: Every Postgres deployment hits it eventually; the fix is usually pooling, not raising max_connections.

queue.error: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM: require() of ES Module not supported
queue.why: The CommonJS/ESM boundary is the single most common Node.js packaging failure.
setState in render or a bad effect dependency; extremely common and the message does not name the component.
Lock ordering problem that only appears under concurrency; needs the detail line to diagnose.

queue.error: Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction
queue.why: InnoDB row-lock contention, routinely confused with a deadlock, which is a different error.
nginx says the upstream failed; the cause is in the error log, not the status page.

queue.error: JWT signature verification failed / invalid signature
queue.why: Key mismatch, algorithm confusion, or clock skew. Security-relevant, so getting it right matters.
Usually image layers and build cache, not the volume people check first.

queue.error: ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
queue.why: npm 7+ enforces peer deps strictly; --force and --legacy-peer-deps have different consequences that nobody explains.

queue.error: FATAL ERROR: JavaScript heap out of memory
queue.why: V8 heap ceiling versus container limit; interacts with the OOMKilled entry already published.
search_path and case-folding, not a missing table. The real cause surprises people.
Named in crashloopbackoff's notApplicableTo as out of scope — another declared gap.

queue.error: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate
queue.why: Missing CA bundle or an intermediate the server never sent. Cross-language.
sys.path, virtualenv and editable installs. Highest-volume Python error.

queue.error: Dynamic server usage: Route couldn't be rendered statically
queue.why: Directly relevant to what we just hit shipping this site.
Exact-match rule in the OAuth spec; trailing slashes and schemes break it.
client_max_body_size, and the layer that rejects it is often not the one people edit.
